text:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promotion blocked for release feature-search: preflight failure on staging. Chart v3.0.0 includes CRD apiVersion bump (SearchIndex v2) which requires controller restart + migration. Change window CLOSED for APAC (no immediate rollout). Options: pin staging to v2.9.x, or perform managed rollforward with migration hooks.

jared: ouch. What exactly failed in preflight?

priya: preflight output:
```
ERROR: CRD schema mismatch: existing SearchIndex v1 found, chart wants v2. validation failed for field `spec.analysis.plugins`.
Suggested action: run CRD upgrade job or keep old CRD until controller supports v2.
```

emily: controller restart -> short ack drain expected. But we have >10k active search shards in prod-edge; rolling controller could drop queries briefly. Not great outside change window.

simon: quick mitigation: we can keep chart v3.0.0 but set `crd.upgrade=false` and `controller.compatMode=v1` as a compatibility shim, no schema changes applied. That would let us promote images while deferring CRD migration.

priya: helm diff shows new fields too, adding `spec.analysis.plugins` array. If we shim, old controllers will ignore new fields but some new features won't work.

jared: product asked for search feature in 3.0.0 but agreed it's ok to delay for APAC. Plan: pin staging to v2.9.4 in APAC and do a coordinated rollforward for EU/NA during change window with ops. Thoughts?

emily: yes pin APAC. For EU/NA we can try shim + smoke. Need explicit smoke plan and fallback.

ops-bot: created job `pin-staging-1742267920` (region=apac) by jared. Logs: https://ci/release/1742267920/logs.

priya: command I used to pin:
```bash
kubectl label namespace staging release-pin=apac-1742267920 --overwrite
helm upgrade feature-search ./charts/feature-search \ 
  --namespace staging-apac \ 
  --set chart.version=2.9.4 \ 
  --wait --timeout 3m
```

simon: for EU/NA canary I'll deploy chart v3.0.0 with shim flags:
```bash
helm upgrade feature-search ./charts/feature-search \ 
  --namespace canary-eu \ 
  --reuse-values \ 
  --set crd.upgrade=false,controller.compatMode=v1 \ 
  --wait --timeout 5m
```

emily: smoke plan for EU/NA canary: run 1m at 100 qps against /search, validate schema, verify no query drops, monitor controller restarts. Alert thresholds: errors >0.3% or controller restart >1 -> abort.

jared: release notes fragment (priya pls): "v3.0.0 adds enhanced search plugins and a new CRD schema (SearchIndex v2). Default rollout will upgrade CRDs; to avoid breaking traffic, operators can set crd.upgrade=false and controller.compatMode=v1 to defer schema migration."

priya: added note to CHANGELOG and created ticket INF-3421 for 3.0.1 that will include a non-breaking shim and migration job.

ops-bot: canary deploy job `canary-shim-1742267975` started by simon. CI: https://ci/release/1742267975.

jared: running smoke now. simon, emily watching metrics.

simon: canary health ok for 5m, no controller restart. P50 latency stable.

emily: smoke passed. Error rate 0.02%. controller pod restarts 0.

priya: given canary green, plan: promote EU/NA but keep APAC pinned until maintenance window (2024-10-03 02:00 UTC). I'll create cross-region rollout plan and update customer comms.

jared: labeling staging-apac as `release-pin` and creating follow-up runbook. ops-bot: created ticket #INF-3421 and scheduled maintenance.

ops-bot: action summary: APAC staging pinned to 2.9.4 (pin id apac-1742267920). EU/NA promoted with shim (promotion id pr-1742267999). Follow-ups: INF-3421 (3.0.1 shim & migration), outreach to integrators, schedule APAC maintenance window.

priya: note for release notes: "If you manage SearchIndex CRDs, plan for a schema migration when we release 3.0.1. We'll provide a migration job and backward-compatible controller mode."

jared: consensus. Closing thread. If anyone sees regressions, reopen with `release-pin` label or @eng-release. :white_check_mark:
